content.json:
# PortOps AI Gateway – Cost & Operations
Live view of the Azure API Management **AI Gateway** in front of Microsoft Foundry. Gateway logs and token metrics arrive in Log Analytics ~2–5 min after a call. Departments = APIM products (`dept-ops`, `dept-it`, `dept-cs`). **Costs below are estimates**: tokens per type (input, cached, cache write, output) × the price table `infra/pricing/model_prices.json` (the same table as the UI page *Cost & usage* and the spend alerts). `UnpricedTokens` > 0 means a model or token type has no price - the estimate is incomplete. The actual bill is in Cost Management.

content.title: Requests · tokens · est. cost · 429 · 5xx

content.query:
AppMetrics
| extend Department = tostring(Properties["Department"]), ModelRaw = tostring(Properties["Model"])
| where Department in ({Department})
| where Name == "Total Tokens"
| summarize Tokens = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Department
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Total tokens over time per department

| order by Department asc

content.json: Calls through `/entra/openai` carry the signed-in **User** and **Team** (Entra group) as metric dimensions. Key-based department calls have no user and show up as `(department key - no user)`. Costs are estimates from the price table.

content.title: Tokens and est. cost per team

content.query:
// PRICES-BEGIN generated from infra/pricing/model_prices.json (USD per 1M tokens) - do not edit
let prices = datatable(Model:string, PIn:real, PCached:real, PWrite:real, POut:real) [
    "gpt-4.1", 2.2, 0.55, real(null), 8.8,
    "gpt-4.1-mini", 0.44, 0.11, real(null), 1.76,
    "gpt-6-astra", 12.0, 1.2, 15.0, 60.0,
    "gpt-6-luna", 0.12, 0.012, 0.15, 0.6,
    "gpt-6-sol", 2.4, 0.24, 3.0, 12.0];
let maxIn = toscalar(prices | summarize max(PIn)); let maxCached = toscalar(prices | summarize max(PCached));
let maxWrite = toscalar(prices | summarize max(PWrite)); let maxOut = toscalar(prices | summarize max(POut));
// add_cost(conservative): conservative=true prices unknown tokens at the highest known price (enforcement);
// false leaves them out of EstCost and counts them in UnpricedTokens (reporting).
let add_cost = (T:(Model:string, Prompt:real, Cached:real, CacheWrite:real, Output:real), conservative:bool) {
    T
    | lookup kind=leftouter prices on Model
    | extend Uncached = max_of(Prompt - Cached - CacheWrite, 0.0)
    | extend fIn = iff(conservative, coalesce(PIn, maxIn, 0.0), PIn), fCached = iff(conservative, coalesce(PCached, maxCached, maxIn, 0.0), PCached),
             fWrite = iff(conservative, coalesce(PWrite, maxWrite, maxIn, 0.0), PWrite), fOut = iff(conservative, coalesce(POut, maxOut, 0.0), POut)
    | extend EstCost = (iff(Uncached > 0, Uncached * coalesce(fIn, 0.0), 0.0) + iff(Cached > 0, Cached * coalesce(fCached, 0.0), 0.0)
                      + iff(CacheWrite > 0, CacheWrite * coalesce(fWrite, 0.0), 0.0) + iff(Output > 0, Output * coalesce(fOut, 0.0), 0.0)) / 1e6
    | extend UnpricedTokens = iff(isnull(fIn), Uncached, 0.0) + iff(Cached > 0 and isnull(fCached), Cached, 0.0)
                            + iff(CacheWrite > 0 and isnull(fWrite), CacheWrite, 0.0) + iff(isnull(fOut), Output, 0.0)
    | project-away PIn, PCached, PWrite, POut, fIn, fCached, fWrite, fOut, Uncached
};
// PRICES-END
AppMetrics
| where Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend ModelRaw = tostring(Properties["Model"])
| extend Model = iff(ModelRaw startswith "gpt-4.1-mini", "gpt-4.1-mini", iff(ModelRaw startswith "gpt-4.1", "gpt-4.1", ModelRaw))
| extend Team = iff(isnotempty(tostring(Properties["Team"])), tostring(Properties["Team"]), replace_string(tostring(Properties["Department"]), "dept-", ""))
| extend User = iff(isnotempty(tostring(Properties["User"])), tostring(Properties["User"]), "(department key - no user)")
| extend ClientApp = case(isnotempty(tostring(Properties["ClientApp"])), tostring(Properties["ClientApp"]), isnotempty(tostring(Properties["Subscription ID"])), tostring(Properties["Subscription ID"]), "(unknown)")
| where User != "(department key - no user)"
| summarize Prompt = sumif(Sum, Name == "Prompt Tokens"), Cached = sumif(Sum, Name == "Prompt Cached Tokens"), CacheWrite = sumif(Sum, Name == "Cache Creation Tokens"), Output = sumif(Sum, Name == "Completion Tokens"), Total = sumif(Sum, Name == "Total Tokens") by User, Team, Model
| invoke add_cost(false)
| summarize Prompt = sum(Prompt), Cached = sum(Cached), Output = sum(Output), Total = sum(Total), EstCostUSD = round(sum(EstCost), 4), UnpricedTokens = sum(UnpricedTokens) by User, Team
| order by Total desc
| take 20
content.title: Top users by tokens (est. cost, USD)

content.json: Derived by heuristics from the gateway log: **401** on `openai-entra` = no/invalid Entra token (`validate-azure-ad-token`); **403 + LastErrorReason `OpenAITokenQuotaExceeded`** = monthly team/user quota exhausted; **403 on `openai` with no policy error** = team kill switch (`TeamBudgetExhausted`, set by the budget enforcer); **403 on `mcp-*` + header `x-portops-mcp-result=wrong-team`** = team key used on another team's MCP path; **401 on `mcp-*`** = missing/invalid MCP key; **429** = tokens-per-minute limit (`OpenAITokenLimitExceeded`). Tool-level blocks are JSON-RPC errors (HTTP 200) - see section 10.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where ResponseCode in (401, 403, 429)
| extend McpResult = tostring(parse_json(ResponseHeaders)["x-portops-mcp-result"])
| extend Reason = case(
    ApiId startswith "mcp-" and ResponseCode == 401, "401 MCP: missing/invalid team key",
    ApiId startswith "mcp-" and ResponseCode == 403 and McpResult == "wrong-team", "403 MCP: wrong team for this MCP path",
    ApiId startswith "mcp-" and ResponseCode == 403, "403 MCP: forbidden (other)",
    ResponseCode == 401, "401 Entra: no/invalid token",
    ResponseCode == 403 and LastErrorReason == "OpenAITokenQuotaExceeded", "403 quota exhausted (team/user)",
    ResponseCode == 403 and ApiId == "openai" and isempty(LastErrorReason), "403 TeamBudgetExhausted (kill switch)",
    ResponseCode == 429, "429 TPM exceeded (rate limit)",
    strcat(tostring(ResponseCode), " other"))
| summarize Requests = count() by Reason
| order by Requests desc
content.title: Blocked requests by reason

ApiManagementGatewayLogs

| extend Reason = case(
    ApiId startswith "mcp-" and ResponseCode == 401, "401 MCP: missing/invalid team key",

content.json: The budget enforcer (Logic App `la-portops-budget-enforcer`) flips the APIM named value `team-<team>-enabled` when a spend alert fires; the gateway then answers **403 TeamBudgetExhausted**. Thresholds below are the spend-alert limits (ops 5 / it 1 / cs 2 per day). Same formula as the alert: unknown prices count at the highest known price.

content.query:
// PRICES-BEGIN generated from infra/pricing/model_prices.json (USD per 1M tokens) - do not edit
let prices = datatable(Model:string, PIn:real, PCached:real, PWrite:real, POut:real) [
    "gpt-4.1", 2.2, 0.55, real(null), 8.8,
    "gpt-4.1-mini", 0.44, 0.11, real(null), 1.76,
    "gpt-6-astra", 12.0, 1.2, 15.0, 60.0,
    "gpt-6-luna", 0.12, 0.012, 0.15, 0.6,
    "gpt-6-sol", 2.4, 0.24, 3.0, 12.0];
let maxIn = toscalar(prices | summarize max(PIn)); let maxCached = toscalar(prices | summarize max(PCached));
let maxWrite = toscalar(prices | summarize max(PWrite)); let maxOut = toscalar(prices | summarize max(POut));
// add_cost(conservative): conservative=true prices unknown tokens at the highest known price (enforcement);
// false leaves them out of EstCost and counts them in UnpricedTokens (reporting).
let add_cost = (T:(Model:string, Prompt:real, Cached:real, CacheWrite:real, Output:real), conservative:bool) {
    T
    | lookup kind=leftouter prices on Model
    | extend Uncached = max_of(Prompt - Cached - CacheWrite, 0.0)
    | extend fIn = iff(conservative, coalesce(PIn, maxIn, 0.0), PIn), fCached = iff(conservative, coalesce(PCached, maxCached, maxIn, 0.0), PCached),
             fWrite = iff(conservative, coalesce(PWrite, maxWrite, maxIn, 0.0), PWrite), fOut = iff(conservative, coalesce(POut, maxOut, 0.0), POut)
    | extend EstCost = (iff(Uncached > 0, Uncached * coalesce(fIn, 0.0), 0.0) + iff(Cached > 0, Cached * coalesce(fCached, 0.0), 0.0)
                      + iff(CacheWrite > 0, CacheWrite * coalesce(fWrite, 0.0), 0.0) + iff(Output > 0, Output * coalesce(fOut, 0.0), 0.0)) / 1e6
    | extend UnpricedTokens = iff(isnull(fIn), Uncached, 0.0) + iff(Cached > 0 and isnull(fCached), Cached, 0.0)
                            + iff(CacheWrite > 0 and isnull(fWrite), CacheWrite, 0.0) + iff(isnull(fOut), Output, 0.0)
    | project-away PIn, PCached, PWrite, POut, fIn, fCached, fWrite, fOut, Uncached
};
// PRICES-END
let thr = datatable(Team:string, ThresholdUSD:double) ["ops", 5.0, "it", 1.0, "cs", 2.0];
AppMetrics
| where Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend ModelRaw = tostring(Properties["Model"])
| extend Model = iff(ModelRaw startswith "gpt-4.1-mini", "gpt-4.1-mini", iff(ModelRaw startswith "gpt-4.1", "gpt-4.1", ModelRaw))
| extend Team = iff(isnotempty(tostring(Properties["Team"])), tostring(Properties["Team"]), replace_string(tostring(Properties["Department"]), "dept-", ""))
| extend User = iff(isnotempty(tostring(Properties["User"])), tostring(Properties["User"]), "(department key - no user)")
| extend ClientApp = case(isnotempty(tostring(Properties["ClientApp"])), tostring(Properties["ClientApp"]), isnotempty(tostring(Properties["Subscription ID"])), tostring(Properties["Subscription ID"]), "(unknown)")
| where TimeGenerated >= startofday(now())
| where Name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Prompt Cached Tokens", "Cache Creation Tokens", "Completion Tokens")
| summarize Prompt = sumif(Sum, Name == "Prompt Tokens"), Cached = sumif(Sum, Name == "Prompt Cached Tokens"), CacheWrite = sumif(Sum, Name == "Cache Creation Tokens"), Output = sumif(Sum, Name == "Completion Tokens") by Team, Model
| invoke add_cost(true)
| summarize EstUSDToday = round(sum(EstCost), 4) by Team
| join kind=rightouter thr on Team
| project Team = Team1, EstUSDToday = coalesce(EstUSDToday, 0.0), ThresholdUSD
| extend PctOfThreshold = round(100.0 * EstUSDToday / ThresholdUSD, 1), Status = iff(EstUSDToday >= ThresholdUSD, "ALERT (kill switch)", iff(EstUSDToday >= 0.8 * ThresholdUSD, "warning", "ok"))
| order by Team asc
content.title: Estimated spend today (UTC) per team vs spend-alert threshold

content.query:
